name: com.segmara/edgar-venture-index
title: Segmara SEC EDGAR Venture Fund Index
description: SEC EDGAR venture fund NAV, top pre-IPO holdings, company profiles, spreads & overlap via MCP/x402.

tools.name: get_top_holdings
tools.description: Paid x402 GET /api/x402/top-holdings ($0.005 Base USDC). Top pre-IPO private companies ranked by aggregate SEC EDGAR fair value and cross-fund count across tracked venture funds ($0.005 Base USDC)

limit.description: Maximum number of top pre-IPO companies to return (1-50).

min_funds.description: Minimum number of SEC-registered venture funds holding each company (1-10).

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Paid x402 GET /api/x402/company-profile ($0.005 Base USDC). Single pre-IPO company SEC EDGAR dossier: cross-fund holdings, combined fair value, valuation marks, and filing dates ($0.005 Base USDC)

company.description: Private pre-IPO company name (e.g. SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI, Stripe, Databricks).

tools.name: get_fund_nav
tools.description: Paid x402 GET /api/x402/fund-nav ($0.005 Base USDC). SEC EDGAR closed-end venture fund NAV, filing date, and top holdings by ticker ($0.005 Base USDC)

ticker.description: Venture fund ticker (e.g. DXYZ, ARKVX, PSVC, XOVR, RVI).

tools.name: get_company_spreads
tools.description: Paid x402 GET /api/x402/company-spreads ($0.010 Base USDC). Cross-fund SEC EDGAR pre-IPO valuation marks and min/max spread across venture funds ($0.01 Base USDC)

tools.name: get_company_overlap
tools.description: Paid x402 GET /api/x402/company-overlap ($0.010 Base USDC). Private pre-IPO companies held by multiple SEC-registered venture funds with fair values ($0.01 Base USDC)

min_funds.description: Minimum number of SEC venture funds holding the company.

tools.name: get_index_snapshot
tools.description: Paid x402 GET /api/x402/index-snapshot ($0.025 Base USDC). Full monthly Segmara SEC EDGAR Closed-End Venture Fund Index JSON snapshot ($0.025 Base USDC)

tools.name: list_sec_venture_funds
tools.description: Free ($0.00, no wallet). List SEC EDGAR tracked closed-end venture funds (DXYZ, ARKVX, PSVC, XOVR, RVI) and latest filing dates.

tools.name: preview_preipo_overlap_summary
tools.description: Free ($0.00, no wallet). Preview top 5 private pre-IPO companies held across multiple SEC venture funds with fund counts and x402 upgrade links.
